title: XML Document Management and Transformation Platform
objective: Develop a local platform concept for importing XML documents, inspecting structure, validating against XSD, querying with namespace-aware XPath, transforming with XSLT, and generating standardized error reports.
skills: Apply the concepts in lesson 176: Professional Documentation and Maintenance

milestones.title: Requirements and data model
acceptance_criteria: State the document purpose, namespaces and required fields.

milestones.title: Build source artifacts
acceptance_criteria: Create well-formed XML and any required schema/stylesheet/query files.
Keep example input, configuration and transformation rules separate.

milestones.title: Verify behavior and failure cases
acceptance_criteria: Compare observed outcomes with written acceptance criteria.

milestones.title: Security, compatibility and documentation
acceptance_criteria: Document resolver policy, data-loss limits, processor versions and recovery.
Provide reproducible instructions and known limitations.

required_features: XSLT transformation to HTML/text or supported output
Technical documentation and reproducible local workflow
stretch_features: Add a structured error report and a documented version migration.
test_plan: Test at least one valid document.
Test malformed XML and one schema/query/transform boundary case.
Test a namespaced example where relevant.
Record processor/version and verify safe resource handling.

rubric.criterion: Correctness and coverage of required features

review_method: Human-reviewed local project with static validation and documented evidence. The CodeLeaf browser playground does not execute XML-specific processors, arbitrary Python, XPath, XSLT, or XQuery.
status_note: Project adapted from Section D of the attached XML curriculum; publish only after reviewing starter files, security notes, and expected outputs.
